title: Decoding the regulatory trio: The role of Nhd1-OsMYB110-OsMADS15 in rice flowering time
content: Flowering time or heading date is the critical stage in rice that helps plants to acclimatize to diverse seasonal fluctuations. Early-flowering rice cultivars are advantageous because delayed flowering in rice leads to yield losses due to adverse weather conditions compromising photosynthetic organ growth or reducing fertility (Tsuji et al. 2013).
